prospective_recovery_sequence: Independent correction verification/adjudication must explicitly permit the recovery scope; no automatic retro-certification of the provisional run.
An explicitly authorized available NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 host, or separately independently reviewed exact-equivalence host rebind, must be frozen before science.

Before any Experiment registration, an independent reviewer must reproduce the token-only exact Qwen3 legacy-vs-stream canary on the authorized host: candidate score/tie/cache equivalence and requested-layer [7,14,21,27] activation equivalence must be exact under the reviewed tolerance/identity contract.

Only if the correction adjudication permits same-development procedural replay, register a FRESH Experiment and Decision using byte-identical population/prereg/scientific variables and optimizer bytes that passed independent review.

That replay must scan exact development indices0..63, first20 eligible/no replacement, and remain DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_ONLY / NOT_ASSESSED; no old provisional result, selected point, eligibility list, metric, terminal label, or partial artifact may be imported.
No code, threshold, control, layer, alpha, selection rule, eligibility rule, population ordering, or host-dependent scientific variable may be changed after exposure.
Confirmation64..127, reserve128..159, valid_seen, and valid_unseen remain inaccessible until a fresh reviewed development seal exists under this corrected lineage.

If correction adjudication does not permit exact same-development replay, STOP with NEW_POPULATION_OR_HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED; do not consume sealed future splits or the 37-path tail as an outcome-driven rescue.
